safety_verdicts.content: Diarrhoea is associated with abdominal pain.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No abdominal pain is mentioned anywhere in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: If abdominal pain were present and omitted, it could reduce recognition of potentially higher-risk abdominal pathology or more severe infectious/inflammatory diarrhea, altering triage and follow-up advice. In this context it would mainly affect risk stratification and safety-netting rather than immediate treatment.

A single episode is usually limited impact but still clinically relevant to document.
